_comment: Waiver register for DOD-006. A waiver is required only when a required test is skipped, disabled, ignored, pending, quarantined or xfailed. The register is currently EMPTY because scripts/collect-skip-report.py finds zero skip markers in first-party source and the runner reports zero ignored tests. An empty register is not a missing one: adding a fabricated waiver to look thorough would be the exact over-claiming DOD-026 forbids. Required fields per entry: id, owner, expires (YYYY-MM-DD), rationale, compensating_evidence.
